item.name: Facility_0
item.creator: MrWindy
item.setting: A compact, foggy facility with simple rooms and a bright neon-lined hidden area.
item.cardSummary: The original Flee the Facility map, built around a straightforward facility layout and a small hidden section.

item.name: Homestead
item.creator: MrWindy
item.setting: A dark farmstead with battered houses, a barn, and a small hedge maze.
item.cardSummary: A rural map with a barn, damaged houses, and a hedge maze that changes how players move between areas.

item.name: Airport
item.creator: deadlybones28
item.setting: A wintery small airport spanning terminal rooms, service areas, an airfield, and a small plane.
item.cardSummary: An airport map with indoor rooms and open airfield routes, updated through later reworks.

item.name: The Library
item.creator: Drainhp, CodedAbyss
item.setting: A two-floor library complex with two large library rooms, surrounding rooms, stairs, and a broken elevator.
item.cardSummary: A multi-level library map whose two main rooms and surrounding corridors create several vertical routes.

item.name: Haunted Mansion
item.creator: BreifAwesomeDude
item.setting: A condemned mansion with courtyards, a basement, and two upper floors.
item.cardSummary: A compact mansion map with indoor floors, courtyards, and distinctive sound details around its freeze pods.

item.name: School
item.creator: Shortfingers, CodedAbyss
item.setting: A damaged two-story high school with classrooms, halls, bathrooms, a cafeteria, a stage, and a basketball court.
item.cardSummary: A large school layout that mixes labeled rooms and open halls with a stage, court, and second-floor classrooms.

item.name: Abandoned Facility Optimus
item.creator: SonicUnkn0wn, Kmart_Corp, VeryCoolSeal
item.replacement: Current remake of the older Abandoned Facility maps.
item.setting: A darker facility remake with cabinets, broken surfaces, and a pool that can freeze and thaw.
item.cardSummary: The performance-minded Abandoned Facility remake, with new hiding and traversal features alongside familiar areas.

item.name: Arcade
item.creator: D4niel_Foxy
item.setting: A neon arcade with maze-like halls, bright game rooms, and darker maintenance sections.
item.cardSummary: A colorful arcade map that combines lively public rooms with quieter maintenance routes.

item.name: Arctic Station
item.creator: CodedAbyss
item.setting: A snowy Svalbard outpost with outdoor areas, climbable windows, and long sightlines.
item.cardSummary: A cold-weather station that favors wide movement routes and outdoor traversal between its buildings.

item.name: Abandoned Prison Maximus
item.creator: SonicUnkn0wn, D4niel_Foxy, mace_nasty
item.setting: A rebuilt prison that keeps familiar rooms while adding routes and spaces for a more balanced layout.
item.cardSummary: The current prison map, rebuilt from the older Abandoned Prison with additional passages and hiding options.

item.name: Sanctuary Zoo
item.creator: GuyGreen8787
item.setting: A large, mostly empty zoo with animal habitats, display buildings, and employee-only passages.
item.cardSummary: A wide zoo setting with habitat buildings and connected service routes that open into a large outdoor area.

item.name: Spaceship
item.creator: 7Siete_7
item.setting: A two-story spacecraft with spacious rooms and futuristic space-themed technology.
item.cardSummary: A large spacecraft map with two levels and open technology-filled areas to move through.

item.name: Nuclear Power Plant (Remake)
item.creator: SonicUnkn0wn, D4niel_Foxy, posyonose
item.setting: A functioning nuclear plant with three buildings, broad outdoor areas, cameras, and a control-room meltdown mechanic.
item.cardSummary: The current nuclear plant map, preserving the original's camera and power themes in a rebuilt layout.

item.name: Ghost Town
item.creator: D4niel_Foxy
item.setting: A dim outdoor town with a train, church hall, barn, long sightlines, and climbable areas.
item.cardSummary: A mostly outdoor western-style town that gives players long views between its scattered buildings.

item.name: Shopping Center
item.creator: D4niel_Foxy
item.setting: A Stranger Things-inspired shopping complex with an open central room, small rooms, and conveyor-style escalator routes.
item.cardSummary: The newest permanent map, built around a detailed shopping center with open sightlines and a complex interior.

item.name: Backrooms
item.creator: posyonose, Nenerii
item.setting: A maze-like Floor 0-inspired map with few clear room boundaries and limited visual variety between areas.
item.cardSummary: A released seasonal map that returns for selected events, including Halloween rotations and the Spring 2026 event.

item.name: Toy Workshop
item.creator: GuyGreen8787, mace_nasty
item.setting: A Christmas workshop with long halls, conveyor belts, gift-filled rooms, and wooden festive details.
item.cardSummary: A released Christmas event map that was later removed from the game and should not be presented as part of the current rotation.

item.name: Abandoned Prison
item.creator: AtomixKing, Duck_Ify
item.setting: A dark, cluttered prison with large rooms and difficult navigation for new players.
item.cardSummary: The original prison map, preserved as a historical row after the Maximus remake replaced it.

item.name: Abandoned Facility
item.creator: iiGalaxyKoalas, Vexhins, Cyrda
item.replacement: Followed by Abandoned Facility Remake and Forgotten Facility; Optimus is the current remake path.
item.setting: A rusted facility with old equipment, dark fog, and no cabinets, removed after performance concerns.
item.cardSummary: The original Abandoned Facility map, now historical after several remake and replacement versions.

item.name: Abandoned Facility Remake
item.creator: Daniel_H407
item.setting: A more faithful Abandoned Facility recreation that used bush areas as hiding spots.
item.cardSummary: An intermediate Abandoned Facility remake that was later replaced by the Optimus version.

item.name: Forgotten Facility
item.creator: Kmart_Corp
item.setting: A blue-fog nuclear research facility with long, sparse corridors and a loose Abandoned Facility connection.
item.cardSummary: A historical facility variant that shared the 2022 remake period before leaving the roster.

item.name: Nuclear Power Plant
item.creator: SonicUnkn0wn, Posyonose
item.setting: A run-down power plant with camera systems, server-room power switches, and multiple escape routes.
item.cardSummary: The original nuclear plant map, retained for history after the newer remake took its place.

item.name: Laboratory Complex
item.creator: BlooIsHere
item.setting: A large, flat two-story complex with broken floors, obstacles, and open dark rooms.
item.cardSummary: A difficult historical facility map that was removed for a planned revamp.

item.name: Sewer Treatment Plant
item.creator: Jackz0_o
item.setting: A split map of dark sewer corridors and a cleaner treatment facility with pipes, water, and debris.
item.cardSummary: A released sewer-and-treatment map that was removed during the 2025 anniversary update.
